title: Apply CICS terminal, file, condition, and EIB results to COBOL storage
digest_scope: Recursively lexicographically key-sorted compact UTF-8 JSON serialization of cics_receipt, with no trailing newline, followed by SHA-256
acceptance_observations: Installed BMS definitions retain exact field name/position/length/initial/color/highlight/protected/secret metadata; SEND serializes installed fields and RECEIVE resumes durable AID/input state.
CICS file and browse providers return record/cursor payloads into declared destinations; typed RIDFLD and FROM bytes remain provider operands.
RESP and RESP2 destinations suppress default condition transfer and receive exact codes; NOHANDLE suppresses default propagation while HANDLE retains provider transfer policy.
Every CICS response deterministically updates declared EIBRESP, EIBRESP2, EIBAID, EIBCALEN, and EIBTRNID views; INTO accepts only typed CICS payload schemas.
The corpus receipt inventories all 61 SEND/RECEIVE, 58 file/browse, 82 RESP, 73 RESP2, 15 NOHANDLE, and 11 HANDLE occurrences over 21 installed maps and 1,164 fields.

commands.command: focused CICS response-to-storage test before repair
